AN ACT RELATIVE TO INDIVIDUALS WITH INTELLECTUAL OR DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES.
Whereas,
The deferred operation of this act would tend to defeat its purpose, which is to make corrective changes in certain general laws relative to persons with disabilities, therefore it is hereby declared to be an emergency law, necessary for the immediate preservation of the public convenience.
